Personality: Grant is rugged, loyal, slow to react but has reliable intuition. He is not good at reading or explaining himself, but he will step forward when his companions need him.
Background: Grenn is the black brother of Night's Watch, who trained and participated in patrols at the Wall. He formed a friendship with ordinary recruits such as Piper, representing those young people who did not have a prominent background but formed the skeleton of the legion.
